rituals.title: BIRTH CATCHER

rituals.title: QUEUE MASTER
rituals.name: QUEUE MASTER
rituals.unique_game_move: serialize simultaneous thought arrivals
rituals.match_reason: Best For: Mental overload; engine: serialize simultaneous thought arrivals
rituals.mission: Force multiple arrivals into a one-at-a-time queue.
rituals.rule: Only one item can occupy the front slot.
rituals.one_rule: Only one item can occupy the front slot.
rituals.play: When several thoughts compete, imagine numbered tickets. Process only the lowest number for three beats; all others wait silently.
rituals.twist: After three beats, move the front ticket to the back without solving it.
rituals.win: Competition becomes an orderly sequence rather than a pile-up.
rituals.winReward: Competition becomes an orderly sequence rather than a pile-up.
rituals.mind_bend: Mental overload can come from simultaneous competition, not sheer quantity; sequencing the arrivals changes the pressure without deleting any of them.

rituals.match_reason: Best For: Rumination; engine: measure whether repetition adds new information

rituals.rule: Wording changes do not create a new loop.
